answer: Put the payout where the review is. Three peers sign a task, not an address, and the stake behind that task converts into a vesting stream that releases over many epochs instead of at once. Leave the queue and the stream stops. Every task carries a cipher tag so copied text cannot inherit the vesting schedule. Incentive again: a farm rotating wallets keeps an empty stream, because the onyx ledger ties credit to the task, and a reused tag leaves a pigment trail back to the copy.
